case.title: Field selection rate is one combined share across all users, not an average
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: about 30 minutes, over two different days of the same week (Monday to Sunday).
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; Admin sign-in for the setup (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button).
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • No Google Analytics access is needed: you read what the page sends in the browser's developer tools (Chrome or Edge). Press F12 > Network tab > tick Preserve log > type collect in the filter box. Click a collect request > Payload tab. Each event lists en (event name), ep.element_location (list, tech_view or board_view), ep.element_label (the field or density), ep.setting_value (on or off), ep.setting_source (default = never changed, saved = chosen earlier) and uid (the user). One request can hold several events, one per line.
  • Turn off any ad blocker for this site, and use a new private window for each user so their messages are not stopped or mixed up.
  • Board View starts every new user with VIN/Serial off and Total price on.

Setup

  1. Settings > Roles & Permissions: create a role with Work Orders View but without See financial data (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST No Money").
  2. Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: four new users at this location (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Rate U1" to "U4"); finish each invite so they can sign in. U1, U2 and U3 get a role with Work Orders View and See financial data; U4 gets the role from step 1.
  3. Check: as U4, Board View > Fields to display does not offer Total price.
case.custom_steps:
1. For each user below use a new private window with the browser tools open as described in the Preconditions (F12 > Network > Preserve log > filter collect). After each user, write down from the collect requests their uid, every work_orders_field_load event for vin and total_price (with ep.setting_value), and every work_orders_field_toggle event (ep.element_label and ep.setting_value). Then sign out and close the window.
  2. Day 1: sign in as U1, open Work Orders > Board View > Fields to display, and turn VIN/Serial on, off, then on again.
  3. Day 2 (a different calendar day): sign in as U2, open Board View and turn VIN/Serial on.
  4. Day 2: sign in as U3, open Board View and turn Total price off.
  5. Day 2: sign in as U4 and open Board View. Change nothing.
  6. Work out the week's figures from your notes, counting each user (uid) once. For each field: the users exposed to it are those with a work_orders_field_load event for it; the users selecting it are those whose last value for it (the load, then any toggles after it) is on. Rate = users selecting ÷ users exposed, over the whole week, not per day.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • VIN/Serial: 4 users saw it (U1 to U4) and 2 have it on (U1, U2), so the rate is 2 ÷ 4 = 50%. U1 counts once however many times they toggled.
  • The figure must not be the average of daily rates. Day 1 = 1 ÷ 1 = 100% and day 2 = 1 ÷ 3 = 33.3%, so their average of 66.7% would be wrong. The correct figure is 50%.
  • Total price: only U1, U2 and U3 could see it (U4 has no financial data, so U4 has no total_price field_load event). U1 and U2 have it on (default) and U3 turned it off, so the rate is 2 ÷ 3 = 66.7%, not 2 ÷ 4 = 50%.
  • Each user keeps the same uid on every event, on both days.
  • The report page itself is built by the report owner inside Google Analytics, outside ShopView, and is not part of this test (QA lead's ruling below).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R10, S12-R7, S12-R13, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) section 3.21 and Phase 10.
  • QA lead's ruling, 12 Oct 2026 17:22 UTC, in the QA session chat, after he asked for these checks to be tested on the ShopView QA branch. Question put to him: “How should I record the analytics tests, now that everything ShopView sends checks out on the QA branch?” His answer, word for word: “Pass on QA-branch data (Recommended)”. The steps were changed on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d) to read the events in the browser and work the figures out with the PRD's own rules, instead of opening the Google Analytics report.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R10: “Report field selection rate by field and display: distinct exposed users selecting the field divided by distinct users exposed to that available field.”
  • S12-R7: “Exclude unavailable financial fields from field-exposure measurement and its denominator.”
  • S12-R13: “Do not count repeated events from one user as additional users.”
  • Tech plan Phase 10 sample calculation: “Each needs a named owner (product analytics, not engineering) and a sample calculation checked against a seeded week (S12-E2).”

Last checked against build v26.40.14-e84b3d1 on 10/13/2026.

changes.label: Steps
changes.old_value:
1. For one field/display, from the events count the distinct users exposed to that available field and the distinct exposed users who selected it.
  2. Compute the rate by hand as selectors / exposed (a single pooled ratio).
  3. Confirm the report shows the same value and does NOT average per-user or per-day rates.
  4. Confirm unavailable financial fields are excluded from both numerator and denominator.
changes.new_value:
1. Day 1: sign in as U1, open Work Orders > Board View > Fields to display, turn VIN/Serial on, then off, then on again.
  2. Day 2: sign in as U2 and turn VIN/Serial on in Board View.
  3. Day 2: sign in as U3, open Board View and turn Total price off.
  4. Day 2: sign in as U4 and open Board View (change nothing).
  5. After the week, open the field selection report for Board View for that week, filtered to these four users if the report allows.

changes.label: Steps
changes.old_value:
1. Day 1: sign in as U1, open Work Orders > Board View > Fields to display, and turn VIN/Serial on, off, then on again.
  2. Day 2: sign in as U2, open Board View and turn VIN/Serial on.
  3. Day 2: sign in as U3, open Board View and turn Total price off.
  4. Day 2: sign in as U4 and open Board View. Change nothing.
  5. After the week ends, open the Board View field selection report for that week (filtered to U1 to U4 if the report allows).
changes.new_value:
1. For each user below use a new private window with the browser tools open as described in the Preconditions (F12 > Network > Preserve log > filter collect). After each user, write down from the collect requests their uid, every work_orders_field_load event for vin and total_price (with ep.setting_value), and every work_orders_field_toggle event (ep.element_label and ep.setting_value). Then sign out and close the window.
  2. Day 1: sign in as U1, open Work Orders > Board View > Fields to display, and turn VIN/Serial on, off, then on again.
  3. Day 2 (a different calendar day): sign in as U2, open Board View and turn VIN/Serial on.
  4. Day 2: sign in as U3, open Board View and turn Total price off.
  5. Day 2: sign in as U4 and open Board View. Change nothing.
  6. Work out the week's figures from your notes, counting each user (uid) once. For each field: the users exposed to it are those with a work_orders_field_load event for it; the users selecting it are those whose last value for it (the load, then any toggles after it) is on. Rate = users selecting ÷ users exposed, over the whole week, not per day.

changes.label: Expected Result
changes.old_value:
Expected results

  • VIN/Serial: 4 users saw it (U1 to U4) and 2 have it on (U1, U2), so the rate is 2 ÷ 4 = 50%. U1 counts once however many times they toggled.
  • The report must not show the average of daily rates. Day 1 = 1 ÷ 1 = 100% and day 2 = 1 ÷ 3 = 33.3%, so their average of 66.7% would be wrong. The correct figure is 50%.
  • Total price: only U1, U2 and U3 could see it (U4 has no financial data). U1 and U2 have it on (default) and U3 turned it off, so the rate is 2 ÷ 3 = 66.7%, not 2 ÷ 4 = 50%.
  • Rounding: write down how the report rounds (e.g. 66.7% or 67%). The number must round from 2 ÷ 3.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R10, S12-R7, S12-R13, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) section 3.21 and Phase 10.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R10: “Report field selection rate by field and display: distinct exposed users selecting the field divided by distinct users exposed to that available field.”
  • S12-R7: “Exclude unavailable financial fields from field-exposure measurement and its denominator.”
  • S12-R13: “Do not count repeated events from one user as additional users.”
  • Tech plan Phase 10 sample calculation: “Each needs a named owner (product analytics, not engineering) and a sample calculation checked against a seeded week (S12-E2).”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
